dialogues.speaker: Lamizana
dialogues.text: ...Does that mean you're willing to forgive me?

dialogues.speaker: Lliwa
dialogues.text: Hah, I didn't say that. Taruka's my brother, and you got him caught up in that whole mess. On the off-chance something had happened to him...

dialogues.speaker: Lamizana
dialogues.text: H—Hey, come on... He's alright, isn't he? And he's a bright kid, he should be able to turn things around no matter what kind of trouble he's facing! You should have more faith in him, too...

dialogues.speaker: Lliwa
dialogues.text: Uh-huh. And who is it that's always saying that he's immature and unreliable, and...

dialogues.speaker: Lamizana
dialogues.text: That was then, this is now! After all that, I see him in a whole new light. So, it would be nice if you could re-evaluate your opinion of me, too...
